visualizations.title: Ω 数学工作台 · 巴格曼—格拉姆三角、二阶射流、无 π 哈尔积分与 p = 5 赫克谱
visualizations.title_en: Omega math workbench · Bargmann–Gram triads, second-order jets, π-free Haar integrals and the p = 5 Hecke spectrum
visualizations.summary: 紫色有理三元球上的四张卡，账本里每个数都是约分后的整数之比，π、根号与极限一次也不进账本。巴格曼—格拉姆三角：o、b、c 所在的 S³ 大二维球上，det G₃ = 1 + 2B − (κ_ab + κ_bc + κ_ca) ≥ 0，c = [b, o, b] 时为 0，o、pHalf、qHalf 时为 1/4。二阶射流：齐次整数对 [P : Q] 的相融度 κ = Q²/(P² + Q²)、展度与凯莱像都是分数，在 ℚ[η]/(η³) 中 1 + x² 的逆在 x₀ = 1 处是 (1/2, −1/2, 1/4)，射流贴着凯莱圆，平直切平面在二阶上偏离，割线偏差有闭式。无 π 哈尔积分：E[κⁿ] = 1、1/4、1/8、5/64、7/128，特征 χ₀、χ₁、χ₂ 两两正交且模为 1。p = 5 赫克：六个模 5 跳跃把 χ₁ 乘以 −2/5，4·5 − (2/5)² = 496/25 > 0；Ω-FRACTRAN 门 Ȳ/5 让 XY 通过、把 YX 拦下。双透镜给出经典实数对照。
visualizations.summary_en: Four cards on the violet rational ternion sphere; every number of the ledger is a reduced ratio of integers, and π, roots and limits never enter it. Bargmann–Gram triad: on the great 2-sphere of S³ through o, b, c, det G₃ = 1 + 2B − (κ_ab + κ_bc + κ_ca) ≥ 0, equal to 0 for c = [b, o, b] and to 1/4 for o, pHalf, qHalf. Second-order jet: the overlap κ = Q²/(P² + Q²), the spread and the Cayley image of a homogeneous integer pair [P : Q] are fractions; in ℚ[η]/(η³) the inverse of 1 + x² at x₀ = 1 is (1/2, −1/2, 1/4); the jet hugs the Cayley circle while the flat tangent plane drifts off at second order, with a closed secant drift. π-free Haar integration: E[κⁿ] = 1, 1/4, 1/8, 5/64, 7/128, and the characters χ₀, χ₁, χ₂ are orthonormal. p = 5 Hecke: the six jumps of norm 5 multiply χ₁ by −2/5, and 4·5 − (2/5)² = 496/25 > 0; the Ω-FRACTRAN gate Ȳ/5 passes XY and blocks YX. Two lenses add the classical real contrast.

visualizations.title_en: Ternion Heap and 3D Cayley Rotation Lab · ℚP¹, Canonical Ternions, 720° Spinors and Rational Rotations
visualizations.summary: 紫色有理球上的四张卡，账本中的分数均已约分。射影圆用齐次整数对 [P : Q] 给出圆上的点 ((Q² − P²)/(P² + Q²), 2PQ/(P² + Q²))，在无穷远点 [1 : 0] 闭合到对径点 (−1, 0)，此时相融度 κ = 0、展度为 1。规范整三元数先消去整四元组的公因子，再令首个非零分量为正。交换三元积的两端，所得规范代表由 (1, 1, 1, 1) 变为 (1, 1, 1, −1)，把同一个有理单位向量 (2, 3, 6)/7 分别转到 (6, 2, 3)/7 与 (3, −6, −2)/7。720° 旋量从约分后的凯莱提升 (1, 1, 1, 1; 2) 逐次累乘，第 3 拍在 −1，有号核为 0，第 6 拍回到 +1。取 σ = (1/2, 1/2, 0)，凯莱旋转逐步保持向量模方为 1，二阶泰勒截断逐步把模方乘以 17/16，十二步后模方为 (17/16)¹²。双透镜给出有理账本与经典角度的对照。
visualizations.summary_en: Four cards on the violet rational sphere, with every fraction in the ledger reduced. The homogeneous pair [P : Q] traces the projective circle at ((Q² − P²)/(P² + Q²), 2PQ/(P² + Q²)). The point at infinity [1 : 0] lands at the antipode (−1, 0), where the overlap κ is 0 and the spread is 1. A canonical ternion is represented by a primitive integer quaternion whose first nonzero entry is positive. Reversing the outer entries of the sample ternion product changes (1, 1, 1, 1) to (1, 1, 1, −1), rotating (2, 3, 6)/7 to (6, 2, 3)/7 and (3, −6, −2)/7 respectively. Repeated multiplication by the Cayley lift (1, 1, 1, 1; 2) reaches −1 at 360°, where the signed kernel is 0, and returns to +1 at 720°. For σ = (1/2, 1/2, 0), the Cayley iterates preserve squared norm 1, and twelve second-order Taylor steps increase it to (17/16)¹². Two lenses show the rational ledger and the classical angles.

visualizations.title: D-有限射流、单纯形锥与有理舒尔实验室 · 凯莱统一、马青包络、二次扩张与舒尔补
visualizations.title_en: D-Finite Jet, Simplicial Cone and Rational Schur Lab · Cayley Unification, Machin Brackets, Quadratic Fields and Schur Complements
visualizations.summary: 四张卡用约分后的整数之比记录射流、锥、自旋壳与二次型。在有理射流环里，Cos_N(2 Atan_N(η)) 化为 (1 − η²)/(1 + η²) 的截断。η = 1/2 时凯莱像为 (3/5, 4/5)，截断误差从 −1/10 起每升两阶乘以 −1/4，马青包络用有理端点夹住 π。在加法环流中，两块面元的共享内边因取向相反而相消，取顶点作锥给出 δ₁(H₂F) + H₃(δ₂F) = F。彼得—魏尔自旋壳由偶切比雪夫核 E_n(x²) = U₂ₙ(x) 着色，E₁E₂ = E₁ + E₂ + E₃，d¹⁰ 的四极为零，d⁸ 的四极对角元为 (−4/7, −4/7, 8/7)。在二次扩张的有理系数账本里，u₉₀⁸ = 1，贝尔值的平方为 8，φ¹² = 89 + 144φ。舒尔补把 2x² + 2xy + (3/2)y² 在 y = −(2/3)x 处的最小值写作 (4/3)x²。双透镜给出经典实数对照。
visualizations.summary_en: Four cards for jets, cones, spin shells and quadratic forms, with a ledger of reduced fractions. In the rational jet ring, Cos_N(2 Atan_N(η)) is the truncation of (1 − η²)/(1 + η²). At η = 1/2 the Cayley point is (3/5, 4/5), the truncation error starts at −1/10 and is multiplied by −1/4 every two orders, and Machin brackets enclose π with rational endpoints. In the additive circulation, opposite orientations cancel the shared interior edge of two faces. Coning from a vertex gives δ₁(H₂F) + H₃(δ₂F) = F. The Peter–Weyl shells use E_n(x²) = U₂ₙ(x), with E₁E₂ = E₁ + E₂ + E₃. The d¹⁰ quadrupole vanishes and the d⁸ quadrupole has diagonal (−4/7, −4/7, 8/7). In the quadratic extensions, u₉₀⁸ = 1, the squared Bell value is 8, and φ¹² = 89 + 144φ. The Schur complement gives the minimum (4/3)x² of 2x² + 2xy + (3/2)y² over y, attained at y = −(2/3)x. Two lenses add the classical real comparison.

visualizations.title_en: Adelic Arithmetic, Free Group and Observer Canvas Lab · Prime Escape, Continued Fractions, FRACTRAN and Memory Splits
visualizations.summary: 四个立体舞台，用整数与约分后的分数记账。欧几里得素数逃逸从前六个素数的乘积加一得到 30031 = 59 × 509，除以表中任一素数都余 1，最小素因子 59 跳出原表。34/21 的相邻渐近分数的行列式交替为 ±1，7/2 对 1/10 的四分深度为 2，此时账本给出 70 < 128。阿代尔卡把 −18/35 的实绝对值与各素数处的绝对值相乘，积恰为 1。三个模方为 5 的赫维茨四元数及其共轭代表自由群 F₃ 的生成元及其逆元，长成一棵六价树，长度为 0 至 5 的既约词数依次为 1、6、30、150、750、3750，六个代表的矩阵模 5 分裂成非零秩一外积。标量 FRACTRAN 程序从 2¹⁷ 出发，走 15 步后停在 22。同一张卡用二维整数矩阵算例演示凯莱—哈密顿恒等式。静止画布是书中的观察者模型，焦点沿球面滚动，记忆切分满足 κ_time + κ_space = 1，例如 u = 1/3 时两项分别为 16/25 与 9/25。双透镜给出经典实数对照。
visualizations.summary_en: Four solid stages with an exact ledger of integers and reduced fractions. Euclid's construction gives 30031 = 59 × 509 by adding one to the product of the first six primes. It leaves remainder 1 at each of those primes. Consecutive convergents to 34/21 have alternating determinants ±1, and the quarter depth of 7/2 against 1/10 is 2. The real and p-adic absolute values of −18/35 multiply to 1. Three Hurwitz quaternions of squared norm 5 and their conjugates represent the generators of F₃ and their inverses in the six-valent tree, with 1, 6, 30, 150, 750 and 3750 reduced words at lengths 0 through 5. Their matrix representatives split mod 5 into nonzero rank-one outer products. The sample scalar FRACTRAN program halts at 22 after 15 steps from 2¹⁷. A 2 × 2 integer matrix illustrates Cayley–Hamilton. In the book's observer model, the focus rolls across a fixed sphere as the memory split satisfies κ_time + κ_space = 1. Two lenses add the classical real comparison.
